verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's first-party React integration page documents building search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch. That is an official path to prebuilt UI components, but the component library itself is a paired third-party library rather than one Meilisearch ships, and the evidence does not name any specific widgets. The "default web interface" in the getting-started docs is a built-in search preview, not an embeddable UI library, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: a Meilisearch-owned UI component library, documentation of specific widgets (search box, hits, facets/refinement lists, pagination), framework coverage beyond React, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official UI component libraries let me assemble a full search interface — box, results, facets, pagination — without building it from scratch

citations.quote: Build performant, responsive search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch.
